visual_brief.subject: GPT-6.1 Terra makes computer-use routing a cost question
verified_context: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra in the API, ChatGPT Work and Codex with computer-use and visual-reasoning support.
Its posted standard API prices are lower than OpenAI's larger GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol options.
The article recommends comparing cost per accepted task, including validation, retries and review, rather than routing by token price alone.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A lower-priced route is useful only when it carries work through the same acceptance boundary.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: Two precise stone pathways pass through one compact routing gate, with the narrower terracotta path rejoining at a shared acceptance aperture.
must_show: terracotta emphasis on the narrower path

candidate_notes.A: Selected: the overhead gate makes two approach paths and their shared aperture immediately legible. The terracotta route remains distinct in every required crop without turning the composition into a diagram.
candidate_notes.B: The oblique routing block has strong depth, but the two routes read less clearly as alternatives and the distant aperture competes with the central selector.
candidate_notes.C: The quiet side view has excellent materiality, but the white route overlaps the terracotta route near the aperture and weakens the two-path reading.

crop_review.article_desktop: The 21:9 center crop keeps both paths, the metal gate and the shared aperture visible.
crop_review.article_mobile: The full routing relationship remains legible in the 16:9 mobile crop.
crop_review.square: The centered square trims the approach ends but preserves both route colors, the gate and aperture.
crop_review.thumbnail: At approximately 320px wide, the split routes and circular acceptance opening retain a distinct silhouette.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared all candidates with the two declared references for matte pale-stone materiality, restrained terracotta and charcoal accents, depth, density and crop-safe silhouette. A best matches the commissioned architectural language while remaining story-specific.

generation_metadata.visual_review: Codex model self-review of three full-size candidates, two declared golden references, a reference-above-candidates comparison and desktop/mobile/square/thumbnail crops. The canonical Playwright contact-sheet renderer could not install Chromium in this environment, so ImageMagick produced the equivalent comparison sheet; repository validation remains authoritative.

A.prompt: Wide tactile editorial still life: two precise stone pathways pass through a compact routing gate and rejoin at one shared acceptance aperture; overhead symmetric composition, terracotta emphasis, no text, logos, interfaces, charts, borders or generic AI imagery.

B.prompt: Wide tactile editorial still life of the same two-path routing metaphor in oblique three-quarter perspective with a compact central selector, terracotta emphasis and no prohibited elements.

C.prompt: Wide tactile editorial still life of the same routing metaphor in a quiet side-on composition with the shared aperture as focal point, terracotta emphasis and no prohibited elements.
